theater: 江淮至金陵（長江中下游）

battle.name: 北宋開國戰爭
battle.theater: 江淮至金陵（長江中下游）
battle.brief: 開寶六年九月，曹彬、潘美自襄州率禁軍東下，取池州、圍壽州；樊若水繪江流圖，倡浮橋與黃金龍戰船，舟師直趨金陵，次年三月城破，李煜出降，南唐亡。羅馬方陣盾未曾入宋，卡上那面凸面咬邊的盾牌，其成牆的遮蔽原理，正對應宋軍以團牌、札甲與偏廂車結成的進攻線。

kit.name: 羅馬方陣盾
kit.history: 凸面的長方盾。羅馬的防線靠盾緣咬住盾緣，不是靠盾牌多厚。

countries: 此役交戰的兩方是北宋與南唐。北宋方面，開寶六年正月已先平荊南、二月盡取荊襄諸州，四月湖南楚王馬氏內訌自潰，直到九月才正式對南唐開兵。主力是禁軍，殿前司、侍衛馬軍司、侍衛步軍司分領各部，兵權歸樞密院調遣，諸將不與部兵久處，是為更戍法；地方守城靠廂軍、巡檢與各州弓箭手，出兵則由禁軍自襄、隨一線東下。糧秣由襄州沿漢水入江轉運，戰線拉得極長。南唐方面，都金陵，李煜主國，中書省、樞密院與內侍省分掌政務與軍令，禁軍之外各州鎮另置守軍，池州、壽州、濠州、泗州這些要地各有重兵屯守。國策以守成安民為主，疆域倚長江之險而兵力不敷，於是厚賞將士、優容降將，卻不肯傾國力以應敵。吳越與宋修好奉正朔，東南一隅始終不敢輕動；契丹與北漢遠在塞外，作壁上觀。
countriesEn: The two belligerents in this campaign were the Northern Song and the Southern Tang. On the Song side, the war machine had already been turned outward in the first months of the sixth year of Kaibao: Jingnan was taken in the first month, the Jing and Xiang prefectures followed in the second, and the Chu regime in Hunan collapsed on itself in the fourth; only in the ninth month did the Song actually open the war against Southern Tang. The main force was the imperial guard, its infantry and cavalry distributed among the Palace Command, the Capital Area Command and the Imperial Guard Command, while the Secretariat of War handled all redeployment and no general stayed long with the same troops, a system known as rotating garrison duty. Local defence rested on the militia garrison, the circuit patrols and the archers of each prefecture, while the field armies marched east from Xiang and Sui. Grain travelled from Xiangzhou down the Han and into the Yangtze, a supply line stretched to enormous length. On the Southern Tang side the capital was Jinling under Li Yu, with the Secretariat, the Bureau of Military Affairs and the Directorate of Palace Affairs sharing out civil and military power; beyond the palace guard each regional command kept its own troops, and strategic towns such as Chizhou, Shouzhou, Haozhou and Sizhou were held by substantial garrisons. Policy was conservative and defensive: the state relied on the Yangtze barrier but never had troops to match it, so it rewarded its officers generously and treated surrendered commanders kindly, yet would not commit the full strength of the country to a decisive fight. Wuyue stayed on good terms with the Song and accepted its calendar, never daring to move in the southeast; the Khitans and Northern Han watched from beyond the frontier.
people: 宋方主導者是宋太祖趙匡胤。他放棄先北後南的老路，改取先南後北，理由說得很直白：南方諸國兵弱，打下江南便有糧餉兵源再圖北方。掛帥的是曹彬，出任西南面行營都部署，厚重寡言，行軍約束極嚴；潘美副之，曹翰總兵。樊若水原是南唐池州的下級官員，多年留心江面水勢，編竹為大纛記入江流深淺廣狹，放流入江漂至金陵，又以舟試水，證明自采石至金陵江面平廣可直下，於是進圖倡造黃金龍舟、架設浮橋濟師。趙匡胤得圖大喜，詔曹彬不許退兵，許以城破之日舉江南之地相付。南唐主李煜志在文章，兵事委之將佐；弟李從善奉使入宋議和，被留京不歸，壽州守將許文稙、泗州守將林仁贍等相繼出降。曹彬入城之日下令禁妄殺、不許私掠，這份軍紀日後成了史家稱道的模範。
peopleEn: The man directing the Song side was Emperor Taizu, Zhao Kuangyin. He dropped the older plan of striking north first and reversed it to north-last, south-first, putting the reasoning plainly: the southern states had weak armies, and once the Jiangnan revenue and manpower were in hand there would be grain and soldiers to press on the north. The field command was Cao Bin, appointed commander-in-chief of the southwestern field headquarters, a man of careful, taciturn temperament who kept his troops under tight control; Pan Mei was his deputy and Cao Han commanded the main body. Fan Ruoshui was a junior official of Chizhou under Southern Tang who had spent years studying the river. He wove bamboo into a great banner to record the depth, width and shallows of the current, floated it downstream to Jinling, then tested the water with boats, proving that the stretch from Caishi to Jinling was broad and level enough to be run directly. On that basis he submitted plans for the great Golden Dragon warship and for a floating bridge to carry the army over. Zhao Kuangyin received the plans with delight and ordered Cao Bin never to retreat, promising him the whole of Jiangnan on the day the city fell. Li Yu of Southern Tang cared for literature and left the fighting to his generals; his brother Li Congshan was sent to the Song court to negotiate peace and was detained in the capital, and commanders such as Xu Wen Zhi of Shouzhou and Lin Renzhan of Sizhou surrendered one after another. On the day he entered the city Cao Bin forbade random killing and private plunder; this discipline of his became a model praised by later historians.
kits: 卡上這面羅馬方陣盾出自西元前一世紀的義大利式裝備，它並不曾出現在開寶六年的江南戰場。羅馬人靠盾緣互相咬合成連續的盾牆，靠凸面把撞擊的力道散開，這種成牆式的遮蔽邏輯才是它真正的位置。宋人自己的答案是另一套：步軍用團牌，桑木為框、蒙皮上漆的圓形大牌，扛在身前遮住上身箭傷；後來《武經總要》追述的步人甲以熟牛皮連綴成札，前抵胸腹、後蔽背脊，把重裝防護同樣集中到正面。與方陣盾作用相近的還有偏廂車，車板並排立起即成活動的牆，推行時護住中軍與輜重，駐紮時可直接環成車城。除此之外，步卒隨身有長槊、刀、步弓與箭，遠射有神臂弓這類大張力的弓弩，弩機一屬如床子弩亦見於兵書記載；攻城則靠雲梯、撞車、攻城車、壕車與砲車，點火一端是火箭，膏油附在箭上，射出去便在城門樓與船板上燒開；水戰主力是平頭船與新造的黃金龍一類大船，內河運輸靠船隊轉運糧秣，戰馬有限，騎兵只用於偵察與追擊。
kitsEn: The Roman scutum shown on the card belongs to Italian-style equipment of the first century BC and it never appeared on the battlefields of the Jiangnan campaign in the sixth year of Kaibao. The Romans locked shield rim against shield rim to build a continuous shield wall, and used the convex face to spread the shock of an impact; that wall-building logic of mutual cover is the place the shield really occupies. The Song answer was a different set of things. The infantry carried round shields, the tuan pai, frames of mulberry wood covered with leather and lacquered, shouldered in front of the body to stop arrows in the upper body. The heavy infantry kit described later in the Wujing Zongyao, the buren jia, was made of boiled buffalo hide stitched into lames, held against the chest and belly in front and covering the back, concentrating heavy protection on the front as well. Working much like the scutum was the pianxiang che, the side-board cart: set up on edge the boards form a moving wall that shields the centre of the army and its baggage while it moves, and when parked the same carts can be closed into a cart fortress. Beyond that, foot soldiers carried long spears, sabres, short bows and arrows; long-range fire came from powerful bows such as the shenbi bow and from crossbow mechanisms of the crossbow family, such as the bed crossbow, all of them recorded in military manuals. Siege work relied on scaling ladders, battering rams, siege towers, wheeled shelters and stone-throwing engines, and the fire side came from incendiary arrows, pitch and oil bound to the shaft so that the arrow burned through city gates and ship decks once it struck. The naval strength consisted of flat-bottomed boats and great vessels of the new-built Golden Dragon type, while inland transport of grain depended on river convoys of ordinary freight boats; horses were scarce, and mounted troops were used only for scouting and pursuit.
tactics: 先南後北的總體次序之下，這一場的戰術是典型的先取據點、再壓城郭。曹彬不急著叩城，兵至襄州便先取池州，把池州當作水陸兩軍的基地：造船、儲糧、練兵都在此處，糧道由襄州沿漢水入江，再由江運至采石、壽州一線，最大弱點就擺在這條千里水路上。曹彬一度因糧遲而議退，趙匡胤遣使持詔不許退師，於是軍心再定。樊若水的方案是關鍵：他以浮筏連接江面架成浮橋，讓人馬器械不依賴渡口直接過江，又造黃金龍大船承載士卒，順流直下，直趨金陵；南唐的重兵卻壓在采石、皖口一線，金陵方向兵力較薄，攻其必救與攻其所不備同時進行。水戰用火箭焚燒對方舟師，攻城用火焚燒城門樓，另以撞車、雲梯貼城，步卒在拒馬與車陣掩護下抵近壕塹。曹彬約束極嚴，入城禁止殺掠，只造籍錄，擄獲不納私囊，這份軍紀使南唐諸城接著望風而下。
tacticsEn: Under the general order of south first, north later, the tactics of this campaign were the classic ones of seizing a base before pressing on the walled cities. Cao Bin did not rush the walls. On reaching Xiangzhou he took Chizhou first and made it the base of his land and water forces: shipbuilding, grain stores and training were all done there, and the supply route ran from Xiangzhou down the Han and into the Yangtze, then along the river to Caishi and Shouzhou, which left the longest water route in the whole operation as the weakest point. Cao Bin at one stage proposed to withdraw because the grain was late, but Zhao Kuangyin sent an envoy with an order that he was not to retreat, and the army's resolve was restored. Fan Ruoshui's plan was the pivot: he lashed rafts together into a floating bridge so that troops, horses and equipment could cross the river without depending on a ferry, and he built the great Golden Dragon ships to carry soldiers, running downstream straight at Jinling. The heavy Southern Tang army, meanwhile, was committed at Caishi and Wankou, leaving Jinling comparatively thin, so the operation combined hitting the place where relief was compulsory with hitting the place where it was not expected. Fire arrows burned the Southern Tang fleet in the river fight; fire was thrown against the gate towers during the siege, while battering rams and scaling ladders were brought up against the wall and infantry closed on the ditch under cover of caltrops and cart barricades. Cao Bin's discipline was severe: on entering a city killing and plunder were forbidden, registers were drawn up, and booty was not allowed into officers' pockets, and this discipline was why the remaining Southern Tang cities fell at the approach of the army.
data: 戰役跨越兩個年頭：開寶六年九月曹彬出師，次年三月李煜出降，前後約半年，正是曹彬自請的期限。城池方面，池州在開寶六年十一月失守，壽州在七年正月被圍破，金陵同年二月舟師抵城下、三月城破，節奏一路不等。樊若水測江用了數十日，竹編大纛順流漂到金陵，回報的江面距金陵只有數十里、廣可舟行；浮橋自石牌口一帶橫江而過，長度以里計，兩端以舟楫維繫。火力方面，火箭焚舟在皖口一戰奏效，南唐舟師盡焚；神臂弓為宋廷最遠的舊式弓弩，弓臂長一丈有餘，須三人張弦，射程約三百四十步，專打城頭守軍。城防用的砲即拋石機，唐宋以來各州城多備，攻城時與撞車、雲梯同用。戰果方面，據《宋史》所記平江南所得州縣以數十計，府庫儲糧以百萬斛計，江南自此與兩浙、蜀地並列為北宋前期最要緊的財賦來源之一；軍力方面，南唐號稱精銳的水軍在采石、皖口一線折損殆盡，餘部多降。
dataEn: The campaign ran across two years of the calendar: Cao Bin marched out in the ninth month of the sixth year of Kaibao, and Li Yu surrendered in the third month of the next, a span of about half a year, which was precisely the term Cao Bin had set for himself. On the chronology of towns, Chizhou fell in the eleventh month of the sixth year, Shouzhou was besieged and taken in the first month of the seventh, and in the second month of the same year the fleets stood below Jinling, with the city falling in the third; the rhythm tightened as it went. Fan Ruoshui spent several tens of days surveying the river, his bamboo banner drifting downstream to Jinling, and reported that the reach of water before the city was only several tens of li away and wide enough for boats; the floating bridge was stretched across the river in the area of Shipaikou, its length counted in li, its ends held by boats on either side. On fire power, incendiary arrows did their work in the fight at Wankou, where the Southern Tang fleet was burned. The shenbi bow was the longest-ranged of the Song court's old bows, its limb more than a zhang in length, needing three men to string it, and it shot to about three hundred and forty paces, aimed at the defenders on the wall. The pao, the stone-throwing engine, was a fixture of the defences of prefecture cities from Tang and Song times, and was used at sieges alongside rams and scaling ladders. As for results, the Song History records that the pacification of Jiangnan brought in some several tens of prefectures and counties and grain in the hundreds of thousands of hu, and from then on Jiangnan was counted with Liangzhe and Shu as one of the most important sources of Song fiscal income in the early years of the dynasty. In military terms the Southern Tang elite fleet at Caishi and Wankou was broken up, and most of the survivors surrendered.
cause: 五代十國留下來的南方割據還有好幾家：南唐據長江中下游與江西，吳越在兩浙，荊南高氏守江漢，湖南楚馬氏瀕於江上；北方則是契丹（遼）與北漢。北宋的難題很明確：這些政權本身並不強，卻各據險要、各有丁口，若不取，南方的糧源與漕運就永遠不能到手。趙匡胤以陳橋兵變奪得帝位之後，先收藩鎮兵權、杯酒釋兵權、推行更戍法，把兵權集中到樞密院與三衙，再定下先南後北的次序：南方兵弱可用，江南是糧倉，一旦拿下，北方才有可能久支。導火線出在開寶六年：荊南內部不穩，宋師一到即平；湖南馬氏兄弟互相攻殺，自潰無力；南唐李煜志在文章，遣弟李從善奉使入宋議和而不得，還被宋廷留京不歸，於是宋朝有了名分。開寶六年九月，曹彬以吊民伐罪的名義自襄州出兵，江南的統一戰役就這樣鋪開。
causeEn: Several southern separatist regimes survived from the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms: Southern Tang held the middle and lower Yangtze and Jiangxi, Wuyue held the two Zhe, the Gao family of Jingnan sat on the Han River, and the Chu Ma family of Hunan clung to the banks of the river; to the north stood the Khitans, that is the Liao, and Northern Han. The Song problem was plain: none of these states was strong in itself, yet each held a strategic position and each had people and land, and unless they were taken the southern grain and the southern canal routes would never come within reach. Having seized the throne through the Chenqiao mutiny, Zhao Kuangyin first took the regional commanders' military power back, disarmed the warlords over a single cup of wine, introduced rotating garrison duty, and concentrated the armies in the Secretariat of War and the three commands; only then did he fix the order of south first, north later. The southern armies were weak enough to be used, Jiangnan was a granary, and once it was held the north could be sustained for any length of time. The immediate triggers appeared in the sixth year of Kaibao: Jingnan was unstable inside and went down as soon as the Song army arrived; the Ma brothers in Hunan fought each other and collapsed on their own; Li Yu of Southern Tang cared for his poems, sent his brother Li Congshan to the Song court to ask for peace, was refused, and had the envoy detained in the capital instead, so the Song now had both a grievance and a justification. In the ninth month of the sixth year of Kaibao Cao Bin marched east from Xiangzhou under the banner of relieving the people and punishing the guilty, and the war to unify Jiangnan opened on that footing.
impact: 這場戰爭的直接影響是把長江以南的中樞和整片江南的糧稅收入交到北宋手上，國力自此改觀。從此宋廷不必只靠中原幾州維持，兩浙、江南、蜀三處財賦連同淮南、荊湖的丁口，變成國家真正的本錢，也才有日後宋太宗三路北伐、雍熙北征的底氣。策略上的意義更大：先南後北被後世視為冷靜的一著，但代價是宋廷在江南的勝利裡失去了繼續追擊北方的餘裕，北伐接連受挫之後，只能退回守勢，保衛的戰線拉得極長。人才與文風同樣被改變：南唐舊臣與江南士族入仕，帶來晚唐以來的文學風氣與藏書，宋代崇文之局自此成形；李煜則從一國之主變為階下囚，傳世的春花秋月何時了遂成亡國之音，讀史者每每在詞裡聽到王朝更替的重量。技術面上，樊若水的江流圖與浮橋成了古代水軍工程教科書式的範本，日後楊吳伐南唐仍仿此架浮橋，火箭與火焚城樓的用法也一路傳下去。留下的教訓則是：曹彬入城不妄殺、糧道自襄州分批運、皇帝詔令不得退兵，這三件事常被後人拿來說明得勝不只靠兵甲。
impactEn: The direct effect of this war was to hand the middle Yangtze and the whole fiscal yield of Jiangnan to the Northern Song, and the strength of the state was transformed by it. From that day the Song court no longer had to live on the few central provinces alone; the revenues of Liangzhe, Jiangnan and Shu, together with the populations of Huainan and Jinghu, became the real capital of the realm, and it was on that basis that later campaigns such as the three-pronged northern advance and the Yongxi northern expedition were made possible. The strategic meaning was larger still. South first, north later has been read ever since as a cool-headed stroke, but the price was that the Song court spent the momentum of its victory in Jiangnan and had no margin left to press the attack northward. When the northern campaigns failed one after another there was nothing to do but fall back on the defensive, with a line of defence stretched to enormous length. People and letters were reshaped as well. Former Southern Tang ministers and Jiangnan scholars entered Song service, bringing with them the literary fashion and the book collections of the late Tang, and the Song habit of putting the scholar first took shape from then on. Li Yu passed from being a ruler in his own right to being a prisoner, and the Chunhua qiuyue heshile attributed to him became the lament of a fallen state, with every reader of the history hearing in that lyric the weight of a dynasty changing hands. On the technical side, Fan Ruoshui's river charts and floating bridge became a textbook model of river warfare engineering for later ages, and when Yang and Wu attacked Southern Tang they still built floating bridges on the same principle, while incendiary arrows and fire against gate towers passed down the same line. The lessons left behind are worth noting too: Cao Bin's order against killing after the city fell, the grain moving from Xiangzhou in batches, and the imperial edict that forbade retreat are three things later writers constantly cite to show that a victory rests on more than armour.
result: 開寶七年三月，金陵城破，李煜素服出降，奉表稱臣，南唐至此亡國。曹彬入城即下令禁止殺掠，登記府庫、造籍人口，把糧米分批運回，軍紀嚴明，江南諸城接著望風而降，殘部或降或散，南唐原有的江防與水軍編制徹底瓦解。北宋得了江南的州縣、田賦與府庫，卻也自此背上新的難題：南唐舊地要設官置吏，要安輯剛歸的軍伍，要有能守住江防的舟師；而吳越仍在東南獨存，與宋為君臣之際，終究要面對納土的問題。對南唐一朝而言，其結局並不只亡於兵：它以十國中文風最盛的一個王國收場，君主以詞名世而亡國，南方割據的尾巴也在此之後僅餘最後兩家。李煜後被封為江南國主，太平興國三年薨。從宋的全局看，開寶六年到七年的這半年，是北宋由中原一隅走向天下之樞的第一步；此後消滅後蜀、平定南漢、拔除北漢，都建立在這半年鋪下的江南基地之上。
resultEn: In the third month of the seventh year of Kaibao the walls of Jinling were breached, Li Yu came out in plain mourning dress to surrender and offered a memorial of submission, and the Southern Tang was finished as a state. Cao Bin forbade killing and plunder the moment he entered the city, registered the treasuries and drew up registers of the people, and moved the grain away in batches; his discipline was strict, the remaining Jiangnan cities came down at the approach of the army, the survivors surrendered or scattered, and the old river defence and fleet organisation of Southern Tang were dismantled completely. The Song gained the prefectures, the land tax and the treasuries of Jiangnan, and at the same time took on new difficulties: the former Southern Tang lands needed officials and clerks, the newly incorporated troops needed to be settled, and the river needed a fleet that could hold it. Wuyue still stood alone in the southeast, and though the two were already ruler and minister in form, the question of surrendering its territory would eventually have to be faced. For Southern Tang the outcome was not simply defeat in the field: a state of the ten that had carried the richest literary culture of its age ended here, and its ruler, remembered for his lyrics, died as a captive. Of the southern separatist states only two were left after this campaign. Li Yu was later enfeoffed as Prince of Jiangnan and died in the third year of Taiping Xingguo. Seen in the wider frame of Song history, those half years from the sixth to the seventh year of Kaibao were the first step that carried the Northern Song from one corner of the Central Plain to the hinge of the realm; the later destruction of Later Shu, the reduction of Southern Han and the taking of Northern Han all stood on the Jiangnan base laid down in those months.
